title: Silent EU868 fallback for unknown plan IDs
description:
get_plan() and get_plan_by_name() return EU868 for unknown plan IDs without warning. This hides configuration errors that could cause devices to operate on wrong frequencies.

File: python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py
Line: 174
close_reason: Verified fixed: get_plan() and get_plan_by_name() now raise UnknownPlanError for unknown plan IDs/names rather than silently falling back to EU868. All 69 channel plan tests pass.
